subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Counting (integrated with number patterns and mental maths)
source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 10s, 5s, 2s, 3s and 4s from any multiple between 0-80 (weeks 1-2), 0-180 (weeks 3-4) and 0-200 (weeks 5-10), and in 100s to at least 500

show.line: Let's count in tens! Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty. Each jump adds ten.

rounds.prompt: Ten, twenty, thirty. What comes next?
Count in fives. Five, ten, fifteen. What comes next?
Count in twos. Twelve, fourteen, sixteen. What comes next?
Count back in tens from fifty. Fifty, forty, then what? Say the number.
Count back in fives. Forty, thirty five, thirty. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Twenty five! Forty, thirty five, thirty, twenty five.

rounds.prompt: Count the socks in twos. How many socks?
rounds.praise: Fourteen! Two, four, six, eight, ten, twelve, fourteen.

rounds.prompt: Count in hundreds. One hundred, two hundred, three hundred. What comes next?

hints: Each jump is the same size. Add the same number again.
Say the counting words out loud. Ten, twenty, thirty.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count in fives. Five, ten, fifteen.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! After fifteen comes twenty, not sixteen.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count in fives together. Five, ten, fifteen, twenty!

parent_line: Can count forwards and backwards in twos, fives and tens to 80.
